analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.lede: How well agnts works for you over time: throughput, quality, where time goes, and what it costs your plan.
analytics.error: Could not load analytics. Try again.
analytics.emptyTitle: No data for this period yet
analytics.empty: Charts fill in as agnts picks up tickets and runs. Label a Jira issue or create a task to get started.
analytics.compared: Changes are compared with the previous {n} days. Green means better.
analytics.throughputSub: Tickets picked up and how they ended, per day
analytics.speedSub: Average minutes per ticket: agnts working versus waiting on you
analytics.turnsSub: Fewer turns means agnts finds its way faster and uses less of your plan
analytics.stopsSub: {n, plural, one {# stopped run in this period} other {# stopped runs in this period}}
analytics.modelsSub: Runs per model and how they turned out
analytics.noUsage: No usage readings in this period.
analytics.spendSub: Tokens Claude used per day, input and output
analytics.spendStagesSub: Where the tokens went, costliest first
analytics.noSpend: No Claude runs recorded in this period.
analytics.reposSub: Where agnts works best, and where it struggles
analytics.noRepos: No repository had tickets in this period.
analytics.hoursSub: When agnts works, summed over the period. Busiest hour: {hour}:00
analytics.noInsights: Not enough data for insights yet.
analytics.insightClaudeMd: Repositories with a CLAUDE.md finish in {gain}% fewer turns. Adding one to {repos} is the quickest win.
analytics.insightWaiting: {share}% of a ticket's total time is spent waiting on you. Reviews take about {review} min on average.
analytics.insightStopsTests: Most stopped runs ({n}) end on failing tests. Clearer acceptance criteria in tickets help agnts know when it's done.
analytics.insightStopsLimit: Plan limits stop more runs ({n}) than anything else. Fewer parallel runs or Haiku for summaries save usage.
analytics.insightNight: {pct}% of agnts's work happens between 22:00 and 07:00, while you're offline.
analytics.qualitySub: Tickets grouped by the prompt version of their first coding run. Compare versions to see whether a change to the agent helped.
analytics.noQuality: No coding runs in this period.
analytics.colFirstPassHint: Done tickets approved without a person asking for changes
analytics.colRoundsHint: Average change requests by a person per ticket that reached review
analytics.colFixesHint: Average times failing checks were sent back to Claude
analytics.colSeriousHint: Share of reviewed tickets where agnts's review found a blocker or major problem
analytics.colFootprintHint: Share of changed files the analysis predicted
analytics.colRedFlagsHint: Skipped tests, removed assertions, silenced linters and the like found in the diffs
analytics.colSelfFixesHint: Times agnts's own review sent findings back to the coder before a person looked
